explication: Hermes Agent is a multi-surface, self-improving AI agent. A user submits a request through the CLI/TUI or a messaging platform; the agent prepares context, calls a configurable model, dispatches tools, and returns a response. It also maintains session memory and skills, supports delegated work and scheduled delivery, and can run across terminal backends. The README documents these capabilities; the supplied source excerpts are partial, so the graph omits uncertain internal call wiring.
